captions.detailed: A 3D model of a historic Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun. It features a long, dark cast-iron barrel with a flared muzzle and a spherical cascabel at the rear, mounted on a wooden trail carriage with two large, spoked wheels. The carriage is rendered in a warm brown wood tone, while the barrel, wheel rims, and metal fittings are dark grey. The barrel is mounted via trunnion revolute joints allowing vertical pitch adjustment, and the wheels are mounted on continuous/revolute axles for rolling.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a Swedish Regimental three-pounder field gun with a slim cast-iron barrel on trunnion revolute joints, a two-wheel wooden trail carriage with large spoked wheels, and a wooden trail handle at the rear.
captions.factory: Construct the field gun using an ArticulatedObject builder. Build the carriage base from box-shaped side cheeks, crossbeams, and a tapered rear trail with a cylindrical handle. Model the wheels using nested cylinders for the hub, rim, and spoke patterns, and attach them using revolute joints on the axle. Model the barrel as a multi-segmented loft or series of joined cylinders (including the main tube, muzzle flare, and cascabel sphere) and mount it to the carriage cheeks using a revolute trunnion joint.
